ValidationRule.description: QAC - If the case is closed, Passenger record cannot be edited.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.Name == 'Service Request', OR(ISPICKVAL( Case__r.Status , 'Auto Closed'),ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Status, 'Closed'),Case__r.IsClosed == true),OR( ISCHANGED( Name ),ISCHANGED( Salutation__c ),ISCHANGED( Passenger_Type__c ),ISCHANGED( New_Salutation__c ),ISCHANGED( Date_of_Birth__c ),ISCHANGED( QAC_Flight_Number__c ),ISCHANGED( New_Last_Name__c ),ISCHANGED( New_First_Name__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit the Passenger record if case status is Closed.
